q1.q: How does GOA MOMENTS support members?
q1.a: GOA MOMENTS helps members with hotel suggestions, restaurant guidance, taxi and travel assistance, nightlife recommendations, and premium Goa experience planning.

q2.q: Can I get help after buying the membership?
q2.a: Yes. After buying the membership, members can contact GOA MOMENTS support for guidance on where to use the membership and how to get better value across selected venues.

q3.q: Are discounts available everywhere in Goa?
q3.a: Discounts are available only at selected partner venues and may vary based on venue, category, timing, availability, and offer conditions.

q4.q: What kind of discounts can members get?
q4.a: Members can access selected venue-based benefits ranging from 5% to 70%, depending on the partner venue and active membership offer.

q5.q: Is GOA MOMENTS only a discount card?
q5.a: No. GOA MOMENTS is designed as a premium lifestyle membership with savings, guidance, concierge-style support, and curated Goa recommendations.

q6.q: Why should I buy the membership?
q6.a: The membership helps you save money, discover better places, avoid confusion, and enjoy Goa with stronger support from the GOA MOMENTS team.
